fields.subject: 120,000+ tech jobs lost to AI in 2026 — here's the skill that's still yours
fields.body_text:
[cid:image001.jpg@01DD3FA0.3B86CC30]
Hi,
Over 120,000 tech workers have already lost their jobs in 2026 ( Article<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/techs-brutal-layoffs-continue-and-india-alone-losing-up-to-35000-jobs/articleshow/132282955.cms> )— nearly half of all layoffs this year, companies say, because of AI. That's not a prediction. That's already happened, in the first eight months of this year alone.
If you're studying computer science, this should matter to you specifically: Stanford research shows software developer employment for workers under 26 has fallen nearly 20% since 2024. Early-career roles — the ones AI can most easily imitate — are being cut first.
Here's the part almost no one is talking about: AI can generate code. It can't yet reliably solve a problem it hasn't seen before, under pressure, with judgment. That's still a human skill. And right now, almost nobody is deliberately training it.
That's exactly what competitive programming (CP) builds. Not syntax memorization, not prompting a model — real problem-solving, under time pressure, against problems designed to have no obvious shortcut.
What is ICPC?
The International Collegiate Programming Contest is the world's oldest and most prestigious competitive programming contest, running since 1970. Teams of students compete to solve complex algorithmic problems under time pressure. ICPC Amritapuri 2026 is the regional qualifier — win here, and the next stop is the ICPC World Finals, the biggest stage in competitive programming.
Why register:

  *   🏆 ₹3,00,000 prize pool
  *   🚀 A direct step toward the ICPC World Finals
  *   🎖️ Official ICPC Asia West Amritapuri certificate — real proof for your resume, not a claim
  *   🧠 The exact kind of problem-solving top tech interviews are built around
Registrations close September 25.

fields.body_text:
#GoogleSkillsArcade




The Arcade Insider




Hey there,

They say the sky's the limit—which is exactly why we're moving past the sky  
and straight into the Cloud to master secure data sharing, advanced  
spreadsheets, and automated deployments this September!




The Arcade Base Camp – September 2026

A fresh month brings three brand-new challenges to level up your cloud  
portfolio.


Arcade Adventure: Modern Cloud Architecture

Hook up Pub/Sub, spin up Cloud Run functions, and dial in your IAM roles.  
Beat the challenge labs to prove you can run fast, secure infrastructure  
without breaking things.




Arcade Voyage: App Modernization

Ship apps without the server headaches. You'll build decoupled  
microservices and deploy across multiple languages on App Engine.




Arcade Trail: Data Engineering and Security

Pipe live data using Pub/Sub and Dataflow, then lock down your storage with  
Cloud KMS encryption and VPC peering to finish both challenge labs.




Game on!




Community Spotlights

Shining a light on our rockstar learners reaching massive milestones:


Anton T. - Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer.
Nelson Oliva Valenzuela - Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer.

Engineer.


That's the playbook for September. Keep building, keep learning, and rack  
up those badges.



See you in the Cloud!

fields.subject: Information regarding further process! | ELUCode-3
fields.body_text:
ELUCode-3

Hi Aditi Lakhera,

The results for our recent major events have been officially declared! Thank you to everyone who participated, contributed, and showcased their skills.

// ELUCode-2 Results Declared
The leaderboard for the second edition of ELUCode is now live!

  • View the Announcement and Winners: https://lnkd.in/p/g-gAttgv

Important Note for Participants:
If your username is not showing up or needs to be claimed, please ensure you claim it before the deadline from the leaderboard page itself.

Domain Preference & Grand Champion:
The Grand Champion of each edition is rewarded with a free .xyz domain for a year. We encourage all participants to submit their domain preferences on the leaderboard page, keeping future editions and rewards in mind!

// ELUSOC 2026 Concluded
A massive thank you to all the contributors who made ELUSOC 2026 a huge success! Your dedication to open-source development has been incredible.
Check out the official results and highlights:

  • Official Announcement: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dc3Sb74odNr/

 

// Next Biweekly Contest: ELUCode-3 September 12th
Get ready for the next edition of ELUCode! Our biweekly competitive programming contests are designed to challenge your algorithmic thinking.
To participate, follow these 3 mandatory steps:

  1. Register on Unstop: https://unstop.com/p/elucode-3-edulinkup-1746285
  2. Register & Link HackerRank: https://www.edulinkup.dev/events/elucode
  3. Join on HackerRank: hackerrank.com/elucode

// ABOUT EDULINKUP LEARN AND LAUNCH INTERNSHIP
Build a real, GitHub-worthy portfolio instead of just collecting certificates. Our 45-day structured program offers hands-on feedback, high-quality curated tracks, and active mentorship. Totally free of cost.

// Available Domains:
- Frontend Web Dev
- Backend Web Dev
- Full Stack Dev
- Data Science
- AI / Machine Learning
- Cyber Security
- Python Dev
- Blockchain
- IoT
- Cloud Computing

Duration: 45 Days

Cohort-1 applications are closed. Apply now for Cohort-2! Early applicants get priority. Slots are limited.
Apply Now

Stay updated and discuss problems with fellow coders!
Join WhatsApp
Join Telegram
